faq.q: What is the origin of Yousaf?
faq.a: Yousaf is associated with Arabic. Yousaf is Arabic يُوسُف (Yūsuf), the Quranic form of the prophet Joseph.
Yes — the underlying form يُوسُف is Arabic.
Yousaf can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Yousaf should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Yūsuf is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Joseph and occurs in the Quran.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Yousaf, yousaf. Script forms are يُوسُف, یوسف, यूसुफ़.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
